# DAX other functions in Lumen

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support status, in Lumen's DAX engine, of every function that Microsoft's DAX reference lists under **Other functions**: 2 implemented, 1 partial and 3 not implemented, out of 6.

| Function | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| BLANK | Implemented |  |
| ERROR | Implemented |  |
| EVALUATEANDLOG | Partial | Returns its value; nothing is logged. |
| EXTERNALMEASURE | Not implemented |  |
| TOCSV | Not implemented |  |
| TOJSON | Not implemented |  |
